description: REGRESSION for DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #3: specificadmintest holds no identity-level ego.dsn.* permission at all (see perm-51) -- only the DSN-specific dsns_auth admin record granted at perm-54, for dsn-sa{{PERMTESTID}} alone. Before the fix, TableCreate's route was gated by Permissions(defs.DSNAdminPermission), which only ever checks identity-wide permissions and has no notion of a per-DSN grant, so this exact request was rejected before TableCreate's handler ever ran. This is the table-create analog of the DSN-level fix perm-55/perm-56/perm-59 already exercise for DeleteDSNHandler/DSNPermissionsHandler/ListDSNPermHandler.
